ontology_source: specialists:docs/design/roadmap/enhanced-prd.md Workstream E (current-canon; identical text in chains-prompt-evals.md §9)
basis.governing_rule: C-09 + native-chain PRD §17 preamble: do NOT create a second eval subsystem or a separate evaluation database; extend the existing Eval Core subjects, entities and grader hierarchy.

entity_model.suite: versioned collection of cases for a capability/regression domain (suite_kind: regression|capability|telemetry|chain|external)
entity_model.case: pinned task + environment_spec + expected_outcome + grader_config; is_held_out flag
entity_model.experiment: controlled comparison of candidate configs; randomization_seed; trials_per_case
entity_model.trial: one candidate x one case x one attempt; carries job_id/chain_id/prompt_hash/rules_hash/skills_hash/runtime_version/environment_hash
entity_model.score: one grader's result for one trial and one dimension (grader_id/type/version, passed, confidence, evidence_json)
entity_model.pairwise_comparison: blinded judge preference between two trial evidence bundles (winner A/B/tie/insufficient_evidence)
entity_model.human_annotation: gold label / adjudication / override with provenance

basis.evaluation_subject_fingerprint: model x specialist version x system prompt x mandatory rules x skills x runner injections x tool catalog x permission tier x thinking level x chain position x task/environment — deterministic fingerprint required per candidate (§9.1)
extension_layers_proposed: 1 SpecialistDefinition/ActivationProfile (prompt/rule/skill quality, tool/capability compliance, structured result quality)
2 ChainDefinition/compiler (deterministic composition, correct mandatory gates, stable IDs/fingerprints, policy expansion, invalid topology rejection)

3 ChainRun/Container (task outcome, evidence correctness, cooperation, recovery/replay, duplicate side-effect rate, remediation convergence, resource cleanup, authority violations, cost/outcome-per-resource)
4 End-to-end promotion (released/deployed behavior, regression fixtures, model/provider/runtime changes)
basis.grader_hierarchy_unchanged: environment/state -> deterministic trace -> deterministic artifact -> model grader -> human adjudication (cheapest-reliable-first); hard gates before weighted quality vector; efficiency reported separately and never compensates failed gates

cross_cutting_rules: All new subjects enter as eval_kinds/dimensions on the existing eval_suites/eval_scores tables; SQLite schema needs no new tables — at most additive columns (replay_of_trial_id, fault_injection_ref).
Whole-chain deterministic graders come first; model graders remain advisory unless measured/promoted (PRD §17.2).
High-cardinality identifiers stay forensic/eval dimensions, never Prometheus labels (reconciliation §13 closing rule; prometheus-projection-contract §3.2).
Eval Core operates observe-only first (V1.2); GATE-AUTH consumes its evidence before any automatic authority promotion.
Pairwise judges and human annotations follow §9.14 discipline (blinding, order swap, tie/insufficient-evidence, disagreement to human adjudication).
